name: Text Generation Inference (observability surface: no TTFT, no KV cache usage, no tracing spans of its own)
notable_features: 21 metrics published in the docs table, emitted from the Rust router via the `metrics` crate with a Prometheus recorder
Queue depth and batch shape are visible: `tgi_queue_size` (Gauge), `tgi_batch_current_size`, `tgi_batch_current_max_tokens`, `tgi_batch_next_size`, `tgi_batch_max_total_tokens`

Per-phase batch timings labelled by method: `tgi_batch_inference_duration`, `tgi_batch_forward_duration`, `tgi_batch_decode_duration`, `tgi_batch_filter_duration`, all carrying a `method` label of prefill or decode

Per-request latency is decomposed into `tgi_request_duration` (e2e), `tgi_request_validation_duration`, `tgi_request_queue_duration`, `tgi_request_inference_duration`, plus `tgi_request_mean_time_per_token_duration`

Every request also carries the same timings as response headers (x-total-time, x-validation-time, x-queue-time, x-inference-time, x-time-per-token, x-prompt-tokens, x-generated-tokens) and as OTel span fields
hardware_caveats: NO TTFT metric. A grep of router/src/server.rs for time_to_first returns zero hits. This is the single most consequential gap in TGI's surface: you can measure queue time, inference time and time per token, but not the latency a user actually perceives before the first token. A TTFT SLO on TGI has to be computed client-side or by joining the x-queue-time and x-inference-time headers

NO KV cache utilization metric. Searching the whole repository for cache_usage or first_token returns nothing; the backends/v3/src/block_allocator.rs contains no metric calls. `tgi_batch_current_max_tokens` and `tgi_batch_max_total_tokens` are the closest indirect signal, and they are batch-shape numbers rather than cache occupancy

NO preemption or eviction metric. The v3 backend can drop requests when its queue overflows (`tgi_request_failure{err="dropped"}`) and can shrink batches under backpressure (`tgi_batch_concat{reason="backpressure"|"chunking"|"wait_exceeded"}`), which is the observable trace of a system that cannot admit work - but the recompute cost itself is invisible

`tgi_request_mean_time_per_token_duration` is computed as inference_time / generated_tokens, not (inference_time - ttft) / (generated_tokens - 1). It therefore includes prefill, so it is NOT comparable to vLLM's `vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds`

The published metric table is behind the source: `tgi_batch_concat_duration`, `tgi_batch_inference_failure`, `tgi_request_failure`, `tgi_batch_max_total_tokens` and `tgi_batch_total_tokens` all appear in the code but not in docs/source/reference/metrics.md

OTel is opt-in via --otlp-endpoint / --otlp-service-name and, when enabled, produces generic gRPC SERVER spans named after the RPC method with rpc.* attributes - not gen_ai.* attributes and not per-token spans. There is no prefill/decode split in a TGI trace
best_for: Comparing prefill and decode batch cost directly, because the batch histograms carry a method label no other engine provides at that granularity
Existing TGI deployments where you accept queue time + inference time + time-per-token as the latency proxy set
avoid_for: An SLO on TTFT - the metric does not exist
Capacity planning from KV cache occupancy - it is not exported
Per-request distributed tracing of prefill/decode; enable OTel only for coarse request spans
notes: Verbatim inventory obtained by grepping every metrics::{counter,histogram,gauge,describe}_!(" name across the full repository tarball (main branch, 2026-10-04): tgi_batch_concat, tgi_batch_concat_duration, tgi_batch_current_max_tokens, tgi_batch_current_size, tgi_batch_decode_duration, tgi_batch_filter_duration, tgi_batch_forward_duration, tgi_batch_inference_count, tgi_batch_inference_duration, tgi_batch_inference_failure, tgi_batch_inference_success, tgi_batch_max_total_tokens, tgi_batch_next_size, tgi_batch_total_tokens, tgi_queue_size, tgi_request_count, tgi_request_duration, tgi_request_failure, tgi_request_generated_tokens, tgi_request_inference_duration, tgi_request_input_length, tgi_request_max_new_tokens, tgi_request_mean_time_per_token_duration, tgi_request_queue_duration, tgi_request_skipped_tokens, tgi_request_success, tgi_request_validation_duration. Definitions live in router/src/server.rs (describe_* macros around line 1990) and the emission sites are router/src/server.rs for request-level and backends/v3/src/{backend.rs,queue.rs,lib.rs} for batch-level. Response headers are set in the same block that records the metrics. Tracing is 63 lines in server/text_generation_server/tracing.py: setup_tracing installs an OTLPSpanExporter with a BatchSpanProcessor, and UDSOpenTelemetryAioServerInterceptor overrides _start_span so that gRPC-over-Unix-socket calls work (adding net.transport=unix and rpc.user_agent from invocation metadata). The equivalent CLI flags exist in the neuron and gaudi backends too.
